Deputy CIO, Portfolio Manager Paul Gannon

Deputy CIO, Portfolio Manager Paul Gannon Paul Gannon joined Findlay Park in 2019 and is a portfolio manager of the American Fund. Paul was appointed Deputy Chief Investment Officer in 2024. Prior to joining Findlay Park, Paul spent over four years as a US equity analyst at Artemis, having begun his investment career at Threadneedle Asset Management.
